# California State University, Fullerton

> > California State University, Fullerton (CSUF) is a top-ranked public university in Orange County, California, offering comprehensive academic programs, international education opportunities, and extensive student support services.

CSUF is part of the California State University system and serves a diverse student body with programs in engineering, computer science, and liberal arts. The university provides robust support through academic advising, career services, research opportunities, and international exchange programs including CPT/OPT practical training for international students.
